name: March Of The Dead Legion
overview: Three hundred years ago a legion died holding the barrows above this village. Tonight they are rising, and they have come to lay siege to it. There is nothing to kill that would end it. The players have to hold the village until dawn.
dreadEffect: Set the Well on fire. If it is already burning, set fire to another district.
setup:
Put The Barrows and The Village into play. The March starts at 0.
Create 1+1{perPlayer} Risen.
Put beat 1 into play.
Set beats 2 to 4 aside in order.
Shuffle the base deck with the chosen modules' cards.
Add the 2+2 {perPlayer}{omen}

boardSetup.name: The Barrows
boardSetup.text:
The March starts at 0 and never goes down.
At the start of the entity phase, add 1 to the March.
When the March reaches 12, the Legion takes the village: the players lose.

boardSetup.name: The Village
boardSetup.text:
A burning district can't be used. The first player chooses which district catches fire. A district that has been put out can catch fire again.
Once 3 districts are burning, the fire spreads: at the start of the entity phase, set fire to a district.
If every district is burning at once, the Legion takes the village: the players lose.

boardSetup.name: Risen
boardSetup.text:
At the start of the entity phase, deals 1 damage to the first player.
Max 8 in play; extras add 1 to the March instead.

boardAddedByBeats.name: The Mist
boardAddedByBeats.text:
The first card revealed each round is {shrouded}.
Can't be damaged. Removed when beat 4 is reached.

boardAddedByBeats.name: The Standard
boardAddedByBeats.text:
At the start of the entity phase, set fire to a district.
While The Standard is in play, Risen have +1 health.

storyBeats.name: The Barrows Open
storyBeats.flavour: The chapel bell tolls at sunset with no hand on the rope.
storyBeats.advance: Destroy 3 Risen during this beat, the March reaches 3, or resolve The Barrows Stir.
storyBeats.onAdvance: Shuffle 3 Roll Call into the entity deck.

storyBeats.name: Mist on the Fields
storyBeats.flavour: It rolls in low and silent, and something keeps step inside it.
storyBeats.advance: The March reaches 6, or destroy 4 Risen during this beat.
storyBeats.onAdvance: Shuffle 3 Grave Muster and 2 The Dead Come Home into the entity deck.

storyBeats.name: The Standard Raised
storyBeats.flavour: A banner three hundred years old rises over the barrows.
storyBeats.onAdvance: Shuffle 3 One Last Push into the entity deck.

storyBeats.name: Grey Light
storyBeats.flavour: In the east the dark begins to thin. The dead know their night is ending.
storyBeats.onReach: Remove The Mist. Set fire to 2 districts. Put 2 counters on this beat.
storyBeats.advance: At the end of each round, remove a counter from this beat. When the last is removed, the Legion sinks back into the barrows: the players win.

town.name: Well
town.effect: Put out a fire in a district.
town.note:
+1{gold} per town action used
While burning, it can only put itself out, and the player who does takes 1 damage.

town.name: Bell Tower
town.effect: Ring the bell: the Barrows don't add to the March this round.
town.note:
+1{gold} per town action used
Can't be used while burning.

town.name: Watchfire
town.effect: Turn every {shrouded} card in the storyline face up.
town.note:
+1{gold} per town action used
Can't be used while burning.

town.name: Smithy
town.note:
+1{gold} per town action used
Can't be used while burning.

win: Complete beat 4: hold the village until dawn.
lose: The March reaches 12, every district is burning at once, or all players are defeated (placeholder).

faces.text: The first player takes 1 damage for each Risen in play (max 4).
Create 2 Risen. Advances beat 1 if it is the current beat.
The first player discards a random card.
Each player exhausts a card in play.
Create X Risen (max 3). Dread isn't checked on this reveal (placeholder).
The first player takes 3 damage. Add 1 to the March.
